CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.POSITION ( ID INTEGER NOT NULL, DATE_EVENT DATE NOT NULL, INSERTED_TIMESTAMP TIMESTAMP, NAV VARCHAR(255), PA_EMITTENTE VARCHAR(255), LAST_EVENT TIMESTAMP, DATE_EVENTS JSONB, CONSTRAINT POSITION_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID, DATE_EVENT) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (DATE_EVENT)
CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.POSITION_DEFAULT PARTITION OF ${schema_name}.POSITION DEFAULT

CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.POSITION_TOKENS ( ID INTEGER NOT NULL, DATE_EVENT DATE NOT NULL, FK_POSITION INTEGER, TOKEN BYTEA, AMOUNT NUMERIC(15,2), FEE NUMERIC(15,2), IUV VARCHAR(255), CREDITOR_REF_ID VARCHAR(255), OUTCOME VARCHAR(255), ID_CARRELLO VARCHAR(255), STAZIONE SMALLINT, CANALE SMALLINT, INTERMEDIARIO_PA SMALLINT, INTERMEDIARIO_PSP SMALLINT, PSP SMALLINT, TOUCHPOINT VARCHAR(255), PAYMENT_METHOD VARCHAR(255), PAYMENT_DATE TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT POSITION_TOKENS_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID, DATE_EVENT) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (DATE_EVENT)
CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.POSITION_TOKENS_DEFAULT PARTITION OF ${schema_name}.POSITION_TOKENS DEFAULT

CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.POSITION_TRANSFERS ( ID INTEGER NOT NULL, DATE_EVENT DATE NOT NULL, FK_TOKEN INTEGER, PA_TRANSFER VARCHAR(255), ID_TRANSFER SMALLINT, IBAN_TRANSFER VARCHAR(255), AMOUNT_TRANSFER NUMERIC(15,2), IS_BOLLO BOOLEAN, CONSTRAINT POSITION_TRANSFERS_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID, DATE_EVENT) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (DATE_EVENT)
CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.POSITION_TRANSFERS_DEFAULT PARTITION OF ${schema_name}.POSITION_TRANSFERS DEFAULT

CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.EXTRA_INFO ( ID INTEGER NOT NULL, DATE_EVENT DATE NOT NULL, FK_TOKEN INTEGER, INFO_NAME VARCHAR(255), INFO_VALUE VARCHAR(255), TIPO_EVENTO SMALLINT, CONSTRAINT EXTRA_INFO_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID, DATE_EVENT) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (DATE_EVENT)
CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.EXTRA_INFO_DEFAULT PARTITION OF ${schema_name}.EXTRA_INFO DEFAULT

CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.EVENTS_WF ( ID BIGINT NOT NULL, DATE_EVENT DATE NOT NULL, FK_POSITION INTEGER, FK_TOKENS INTEGER, INSERTED_TIMESTAMP_REQ TIMESTAMP, INSERTED_TIMESTAMP_RESP TIMESTAMP, EVENT_ID_REQ VARCHAR(255), EVENT_ID_RESP VARCHAR(255), FAULT_CODE SMALLINT, OUTCOME_REQ VARCHAR(255), OUTCOME_RESP VARCHAR(255), TIPO_EVENTO SMALLINT, CONSTRAINT EVENTS_WF_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID, DATE_EVENT) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (DATE_EVENT)
CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.EVENTS_WF_DEFAULT PARTITION OF ${schema_name}.EVENTS_WF DEFAULT
